subject.title: [Bug]: ensureGlobalUndiciEnvProxyDispatcher() breaks COS chunked upload via qqbot plugin

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked PR's generic enhanced NO_PROXY handling at the process-wide global Undici dispatcher layer as the fix for this qqbot/COS media delivery regression?
rationale: The report is a real message-delivery regression candidate, but the likely fix affects process-wide direct-egress decisions under proxy configuration, which is a security and operator-policy boundary rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept generic dispatcher fix after review
options.body: Land the linked generic NO_PROXY dispatcher repair once its reset, docs, tests, and security-boundary proof satisfy maintainers, then close this issue as implemented.

options.title: Narrow the fix to QQBot transport
options.body: Reject the global bypass boundary and require the QQBot/plugin upload path to own a direct dispatcher or safer upload-specific proxy policy.

options.title: Hold for live repro
options.body: Keep both the issue and linked PR open until a maintainer or contributor proves the exact qqbot/COS failure and the before/after media delivery path.

recommendation.title: Accept generic dispatcher fix after review
recommendation.body: Land the linked generic NO_PROXY dispatcher repair once its reset, docs, tests, and security-boundary proof satisfy maintainers, then close this issue as implemented.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the clearest recent merged history on the matchesNoProxy/trusted-env proxy helper boundary that the active fix proposes to extend globally.
